title: Nets and views of objects
log: 2026-11-04T09:36:55Z write: the API refused it in the chapter request, so it is written on its own next

draft.title: Nets and views of objects
card: a flat pattern that folds up into a 3D object. It shows every face joined edge to edge, so you can see the shape of each face.
front, side and top views show the object as seen from one direction. Each view is a flat shape, and it shows only what faces that direction.
a drawing that shows the object as the eye sees it, with several faces at once. Parts that are further away look smaller.
A cylinder has a net of 2 circles and 1 rectangle. Its top view is a circle. Its front view is a rectangle.
draft.remember: A net folds up into the object. Views and perspective show how it looks from outside.

a.q: Which drawing of a box shows all of its faces as flat shapes that can be folded up to make it?
a.why: A net lays out every face flat, joined edge to edge, so it can be folded into the box. A perspective drawing shows the box as it looks, but some faces are hidden and the shapes are not drawn at their true size.
a.clue: Which drawing could you cut out and fold?

b.q: Sam looks straight down at a cylindrical tin standing on its end. What shape does he see?
b.why: This is the top view. The top face of a cylinder is a circle. A rectangle is the front view, which is a different direction.
b.clue: A top view shows only the face that points up.
